mechanism: Ibuprofen reduces renal blood flow and glomerular filtration rate, impairing tobramycin elimination and increasing nephrotoxicity risk, particularly with aminoglycosides which are renally cleared and have narrow therapeutic indices.
action: Monitor serum creatinine and tobramycin levels closely; consider alternative analgesics (acetaminophen); ensure adequate hydration and assess renal function baseline and periodically during concurrent use.
